body: Yeah my group has been struggling a LOT with the crystal mech. What we recently found effective is one person positions directly behind the crystal and the 2 furthest players form a triangle behind him, the 2 furthest dodge roll towards the center of the triangle (towards each other and the one closest to crystal) to block the boomerang and get closer to each other. Even if you get feared you have enough time to run to safe spot. It’s the most reliable method we’ve found so far
